summary: Barnwell Industries' board approved terminating its Employees Pension Plan effective on or about November 30, 2026, with benefits distributed via irrevocable annuity commitments; surplus assets would revert to the company after all liabilities are satisfied. The 8-K, filed October 5, 2026, also furnishes the announcing press release under Regulation FD. No figures were disclosed. This pension-reversion announcement is a potential capital-return event, though the surplus amount, timing and regulatory approvals remain unknown. What to watch: annuity pricing, plan asset performance, regulatory review and the eventual reversion size.
